# Parse full Simple Note 'Movie Recommendations' for movies with director 'Peter Jackson'
import re

sn_pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=2705)
content=note['content']

# Extract blocks: title line then subsequent lines with director
lines=content.splitlines()
titles=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None

for line in lines:
    # title lines often start with something not indented and not starting with '#'
    if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '):
        if line.strip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        # title candidate: not bullet lines and not ' - director:' etc
        if not line.strip().lower().startswith('director:') and not line.strip().lower().startswith('genre:'):
            # if previous director/genre belonged to previous title, save if director matches
            # But we need director match for each title block. We'll detect new title when we see non-bulleted line.
            current_title=line.strip()
            current_director=None
            continue

    m=re.match(r'\s*-\s*director:\s*(.*)', line)
    if m and current_title:
        current_director=m.group(1).strip()

    # when we encounter genre line, block ends; or when next title begins.
    m2=re.match(r'\s*-\s*genre:\s*(.*)', line)
    if m2 and current_title and current_director:
        if current_director=='Peter Jackson':
            titles.append(current_title)
        current_title=None
        current_director=None

print('extracted', len(titles))
print(titles)
